sentences.text: Code vs In Re : Rabi Munda on 11 January, 2024

Bench: Debangsu Basak 11.01.2024 Item No.48(D.L.) Ct.No.29 srm/dc.
Allowed C.R.M. (A) 4975 of 2023 In Re : An Application for anticipatory bail under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure filed in connection with Gangnapur Police Station Case No. 504 of 2022 dated 12.10.2022 under Sections 498A/307/34 of the Indian Penal Code.

entities.text: Gangnapur Police Station Case No. 504 of 2022
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
And  In Re : Rabi Munda  ... Petitioner.
 Mr. Prabir Kumar Majumdar  ... For the Petitioner.
 Ms. Sutapa Banerjee  ... For the State.
Petitioner prays for anticipatory bail.
Petitioner before us is the father-in-law.
The husband was arrested and granted bail by the jurisdictional court.
In such circumstances, we grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

Accordingly, we direct that in the event of arrest the petitioner shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten thousand only), with two sureties of like amount each, to the satisfaction of the arresting officer and also subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 and on condition that the petitioner shall appear on every date before the jurisdictional court on and from the date fixed for appearance of the accused and in default, the jurisdictional court will pass appropriate order to secure the presence of the petitioner in court including cancelling the anticipatory bail granted without further reference to this Court.
The application for anticipatory bail is, thus, allowed. CRM(A) 4975 of 2023 is disposed of.
(Debangsu Basak, J.) (Md. Shabbar Rashidi, J.)
